scientific_limitations: Generic area-uniform interior points of nondegenerate Euclidean parallelograms only; excludes transition-line cases of measure zero and non-Euclidean normals. Older Hann (1993) and Hug (1995) full texts could not be inspected; historical priority remains provisional.
title: The complete three-atom normal law and a sharp aspect transition for parallelograms
